name: Product
description: Allow products to be submitted to the store and displayed on pages.
project_description: Product is the central Arch submodule: it defines the fieldable, revisionable, translatable `product` content entity and its `product_type` bundles, closely modelled on Drupal core's node system. Products have SKU, title, status, owner, availability and a price field; a full node-style grant access system (ProductGrantDatabaseStorage / ProductAccessControlHandler / hook_product_grants) controls who may view, edit or delete each product. The module ships product add/edit/delete forms, a products admin listing with bulk actions, a preview workflow, revision UI, Views integration, tokens and a store-dashboard product count.
